mechanics.claim: While Mounted, all damage dealt to Kled and Skaarl is suffered by Skaarl first, and additional health sources apply to Skaarl's maximum health.
mechanics.quote: While {{sbc|Mounted}}, all damage dealt to the duo is suffered by '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''', who has {{pplevel|...}}

mechanics.claim: Percentage-health effects use Kled and Skaarl's combined maximum health.
mechanics.quote: Effects based on percentage health consider '''Kled''' and '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' combined {{as|'''maximum''' health}}.

mechanics.claim: When Skaarl's health is reduced below 0, Kled dismounts and excess damage beyond Skaarl's health is ignored.
mechanics.quote: Being reduced below {{as|{{sti|health|0 health}}}} causes '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' to flee, forcing '''Kled''' to be {{sbc|Dismounted}}, with all damage in excess of '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' health being ignored.

mechanics.claim: Dismounting cleanses crowd control and makes Kled unable to act, untargetable, and immune to crowd control for 0.5 seconds.
mechanics.quote: cleansing himself of all {{tip|crowd control}} and becoming {{tip|lockout|unable to act}}, {{tip|untargetable}}, and {{tip|cc-immune|immune to crowd control}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds

mechanics.claim: Dismounting resets the cooldown and charges of Pocket Pistol.
mechanics.quote: {{ai|Dismounted Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard|Kled|''Dismounting''}} resets the {{sti|cooldown}} and charges of ''{{ai|Pocket Pistol|Kled}}''.

mechanics.claim: While Dismounted, Kled's basic attacks deal reduced damage to champions.
mechanics.quote: his attacks deal {{pp|85 to 100 for 4|1;6;11;16|key=%}} damage to champions

mechanics.claim: While Dismounted, Kled cannot cast Bear Trap on a Rope, Jousting, or Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, and Bear Trap on a Rope is replaced with Pocket Pistol.
While Mounted, healing and health regeneration first replenish Skaarl's health and only apply to Kled's health once Skaarl is at full health.
mechanics.quote: healing and {{as|{{sti|health regeneration}}}} will first replenish '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' health and will only apply to '''Kled's''' health while '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' is at ''full'' health

mechanics.claim: If Skaarl's health is reduced below 0 by an attack or ability with multiple damage instances, subsequent instances from the same cast are reduced to 0 damage.
mechanics.quote: If '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' health is reduced below 0 by an attack or ability with multiple damage instances, subsequent damage instances from the same {{tip|cast instance}} are reduced to 0 damage.

mechanics.claim: If Kled would be executed while Mounted, he is instead only Dismounted.
mechanics.quote: If '''Kled''' would be {{tip|execute|executed}} while {{sbc|Mounted}}, he is instead only {{sbc|Dismounted}}.
